negative_findings.description: Every attempted direct fetch of a www.nbrm.mk page (payment statistics EN, statistics hub MK) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, while the same URLs are search-indexed and cross-linked.
negative_findings.result_summary: 2 of 2 attempted www.nbrm.mk .nspx fetches returned 403; nbstat.nbrm.mk fetched fine. Hypothesis: WAF/user-agent filtering, not a dead site. Not verified as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be planned around a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, JS, cookies) or around direct static file paths (/content/, /WBStorage/Files/) and the NBStat API — a naive HTTP crawler will report the entire central-bank source set as unreachable.

negative_findings.description: The NBStat PxWeb portal root was fetched successfully and exposes only three database trees: External Statistics, Financial Accounts, and Monetary and Interest Rates Statistics.
negative_findings.result_summary: No payment/card/ATM/POS database found in NBStat during this pass; payment statistics appear to remain outside the machine-readable PxWeb platform and to be published as page-attached files on www.nbrm.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most collectable channel (PxWeb API) does not currently cover the cell's highest-priority topics, so card/ATM/POS series require file-level scraping and manual schema handling.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately-titled periodic 'payment systems report' / 'извештај за работењето на платните системи' landing page was positively identified for NBRSM in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Macedonian and English surfaced the payment statistics page, the MIPS/KIBS pages and the annual report, but no distinct recurring payment-systems oversight report page. It may exist behind the 403 or be folded into the Annual Report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If such a report exists it would be the densest single narrative source for MIPS/KIBS/card infrastructure; leaving it unlocated risks a systematic blind spot.

negative_findings.description: No current 'статистички билтен' / statistical bulletin product page was confirmed for NBRSM.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted bilingual search returned only the general statistics and payment-statistics pages; the bulletin may have been discontinued in favour of NBStat, or may be reachable only from behind the 403.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A bulletin would provide a stable, versioned snapshot of many series in one file, which is far cheaper to archive than dozens of individual tables.

negative_findings.description: The NBStat API is referenced in NBRSM's own announcement but no API base URL or documentation page was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Announcement page (ns-newsarticle-soopstenie-18122019-en.nspx) states users can access NBStat data through an API; the concrete endpoint/doc URL was not found. PxWeb's conventional /api/v1/ pattern is a hypothesis only and was not tested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirming the API base and table registry would turn most monetary/cash-usage collection into a low-maintenance scheduled job.

negative_findings.description: No public UJP dataset or dashboard giving the number of installed/active fiscal devices (фискални апарати) or aggregate fiscalised turnover as a downloadable time series was found. Such figures appear only narratively inside annual reports and press statements.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fiscal-device counts are the closest public proxy for the MK POS/cash-register installed base; absence forces PDF table extraction or an FOI request rather than a clean feed.

negative_findings.description: The Central Registry does not appear to publish a free, bulk, machine-readable company register or an open API for the Trade Register; structured access runs through the paid Дистрибутивен систем and fee-based per-entity services.

negative_findings.result_summary: Four candidate roots are plausible but not fetched; only deeper paths or third-party references were observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as collectible; the FIC White Book in particular was only observed as a 2018 PDF.

negative_findings.description: mchamber.mk serves the same content under two URL schemes — legacy ASPX query strings (Default.aspx?mId=..&id=..&lng=1, and news by evid) and newer REST-like paths (/mk/home/zdruzenijainfo/{n}, /mk/home/grupacii/{n}). An archive subdomain arhiva.mchamber.mk holds older documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dual URL scheme plus separate archive host.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler will either duplicate every page or miss half the site, and will silently drop the historical document set on the archive host.

negative_findings.description: The term 'комора' matches many professional chambers unrelated to banking or payments (e.g. Стоматолошка комора / dental chamber), and 'Стопанска' collides heavily with Стопанска банка, whose tariff and fee PDFs dominate results for fee-related queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two high-frequency false-positive clusters identified in Macedonian querying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated query expansion on these terms will fill the pipeline with bank tariff PDFs and medical chambers unless negative terms are applied.

negative_findings.description: Fokus (fokus.mk) is named in the coverage cell, and its existence as an MK weekly is corroborated, but no banking/payments/ATM article from fokus.mk surfaced across five MK-language and two Albanian-language searches in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outlet exists; topical yield for banking/payments unverified. Recorded as a low-confidence candidate rather than dropped or invented.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Investigative weeklies are the likeliest venue for tender and supervision disputes that never enter statistics; if fokus.mk in fact carries none, monitoring budget should shift to bankarstvo.mk and Portalb.

negative_findings.description: MK-language searching for a declining ATM count and mass branch closures (намален број банкомати, затворање експозитури) returned only individual, temporary single-branch closure notices and a 2010-vintage ATM density figure — no journalism tracking ATM estate size over time.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK media source currently produces a longitudinal ATM/branch estate series; bank estate pages (e.g. nlb.mk/ekspozituri/bankomati) are the de-facto substitute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ATM/POS estate question central to workstream A4 cannot be answered from media alone; it must be built from NBRM series plus per-bank locator scraping, with media used only for event detection.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language queries for MK banking repeatedly returned Republic of Albania sources (Banka e Shqipërisë, sot.com.al, albeu.com) rather than MK ones, because “Banka Popullore”/“pagesa me kartë” are shared terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian queries must be constrained with MK-specific tokens (RMV, Maqedoni e Veriut, Shkup, Tetovë) or domain filters (portalb.mk, alsat.mk, koha.mk) to avoid AL contamination.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Uncontrolled Albanian collection would silently import Albanian (AL) payment statistics into an MK dataset — a serious data-integrity risk.

negative_findings.description: Koha.mk and Shenja — both named or implied as Albanian-language MK outlets — did not return any indexed banking/payments article in this pass despite being included in the query string.
negative_findings.result_summary: No verified URL obtained; deliberately not recorded as candidates rather than guessing homepage URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Albanian-language MK coverage currently rests on Portalb and Alsat alone; a second-source check for western MK is missing.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was confirmed for any outlet in this cell; suggested feed paths (e.g. WordPress /feed/) are inferences from platform conventions, not observed endpoints.
negative_findings.result_summary: Feed discovery deferred to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Feed-based collection is far cheaper and more polite than HTML crawling; confirming feeds should precede building scrapers.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for MK bank vacancies mentioning ISO8583, acquiring or core banking returned no vacancy listings at all — only Wikipedia bank entries and open-banking directories.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero relevant hits; confirms MK payments vacancies are advertised almost exclusively in Macedonian and are invisible to English queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design for this cell must be Macedonian-first; an English-only monitor would report a false null on hiring activity.

negative_findings.description: No MK-language vacancy text encountered in this pass used the term 'ISO8583' or an obvious Macedonian equivalent; MK ads describe the domain functionally ('картично работење', 'банкомати', 'самоуслужни производи') rather than by protocol name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Protocol-level keywords are the wrong filter for MK job text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A keyword list built from Western payments jargon will miss most MK ads. Filters must use functional Macedonian vocabulary.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn company pages for MK banks, KIBS and vendors are the single richest indirect signal but are behind an auth wall and covered by ToS prohibiting automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content exists and is partially visible via search-engine snippets; systematic automated collection is not permissible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-yield source in this cell cannot be pipelined; budget manual analyst time or an authorised data route instead of assuming a scraper.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, MK-hosted payments or cards conference (a 'Skopje Payments Summit' equivalent) was identified. MK payments discussion is distributed across e-commerce, ICT-chamber and general business events, or happens at regional events abroad.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone national payments conference found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Event monitoring must be multi-venue rather than anchored on one flagship event; absence itself is an intelligence datum about market maturity.

negative_findings.description: No MK bank or vendor career page (kb.com.mk, stb.com.mk, nlb.mk, halkbank.mk, casys.com.mk, kibs.mk) was opened and confirmed in this pass; their existence and URL shape are inferred from third-party references only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Primary career-page layer remains unmapped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Aggregators lag and filter; primary career pages are the authoritative first-publication point and must be enumerated before the collection design is fixed.

negative_findings.description: No specific NBRSM working paper on cash usage, card acceptance or payment habits was located by title in this pass — only the section-level pages that should host such papers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Container located, individual items not enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The research layer of this cell is asserted at section level only; item-level enumeration is still owed.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) sources were sought or found, despite Albanian being widely used in North Macedonia including by some banks and in Tetovo/Skopje-area universities.
negative_findings.result_summary: sq layer entirely absent from this pass (run scope specified mk+en only).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A meaningful slice of MK job ads, event coverage and university output is Albanian-language and is being systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/statistika-en.nspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no NBRM page could be opened directly in this run; all NBRM entries rest on search-result evidence plus URL patterns observed in those results.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on the central bank statistics hub; sibling NBRM URLs (currency pages, payment statistics, monthly monetary press-release PDFs) were surfaced by search but not opened.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The central bank is the single most important source for this cell (currency in circulation, ATM/POS counts). The collector must use a browser-grade fetcher for nbrm.mk rather than a plain HTTP client, and these URLs must be treated as unverified until a liveness pass runs.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated NBRM research output on the determinants of high cash usage was located, although one search snippet referenced an NBRM workshop titled around 'High level of cash in circulation in Republic of Macedonia'. The workshop page or paper itself was not surfaced as a URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Evidence that such NBRM analytical material exists, but no retrievable link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A central-bank study on why cash use is high would be the anchor document for this cell; its absence is a real gap rather than evidence it does not exist.

negative_findings.description: No primary Службен весник (Official Gazette) URL for either the Law on Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (with the Art. 204 cash ceiling) or the Law on Registration of Cash Payments was obtained. Only secondary and practitioner renderings of the thresholds were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-limit thresholds (EUR 3,000 to 2,000 from 2024, to 1,000 from 2025; EUR 500 for virtual-asset cash exchange; MKD 6,000 per transaction and MKD 60,000 monthly for legal entities) are consistently reported across independent secondary sources but lack a primary-gazette citation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-limit policy is a headline variable for this cell; without the gazette text the numbers cannot be dated or version-controlled reliably.

negative_findings.description: No explicit legal instrument mandating card acceptance by merchants was found. The searches surfaced only the fiscalisation duty (register every cash payment via an approved fiscal device, issue a fiscal receipt including for card payments), not an obligation to offer card payment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mandatory card acceptance may not exist as a standalone rule in North Macedonia, or is embedded elsewhere (e.g. the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems) and was not reached.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Whether card acceptance is mandatory or merely incentivised changes the entire acceptance-growth thesis for the market; this needs a definitive answer from the payment-services law and UJP fiscalisation rulebook.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was consumed before two planned queries could run: NBRM research on high cash in circulation, and the consolidated text of the Law on Registration of Cash Payments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two intended local-language and English queries were refused with a budget message.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell is good on infrastructure and policy but thinner on central-bank analytical literature and primary legal texts; a follow-up run with budget should start from those two queries.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language term set was established for de-cashing / cashless-society programmes as a policy category; searches in Macedonian on cash reduction returned AML limits and fiscalisation rather than an identifiable national de-cashing programme vocabulary.
negative_findings.result_summary: The concept appears to be expressed indirectly in MK through 'формализирање на неформалната економија' and 'безготовинско плаќање' rather than a dedicated programme name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the right local term a genuine national cashless programme could be missed entirely; a follow-up should test 'безготовинско плаќање', 'безготовинско општество' and 'намалување на готовинско работење'.

negative_findings.description: No aggregator was found that carries a normalised North Macedonia POS-terminal count series in an openly accessible form. CEIC's MK payment-system pages surface ATM density (World Bank-sourced) but the searches surfaced no public MK POS-terminal or card-transaction-count series; the IMF FAS is the only cross-country source indicated to collect POS terminals, and even there the MK POS coverage was not directly observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM counts are well covered by aggregators (WB, IMF FAS, FRED, CEIC); POS terminals and card transaction volumes are not, in any free aggregator found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POS terminal counts are the core Printec-relevant metric; if no aggregator carries them, the collection design must rely on NBRSM primary releases plus Wayback back-fill rather than on a comparator database.

negative_findings.description: North Macedonia does not report to ECB payments statistics (the ECB set covers euro area and most non-euro EU member states; MK is a candidate country, not an EU member).
negative_findings.result_summary: ECB PAY is usable only as a comparator/benchmark layer, never as a source of MK figures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a costly and wrong assumption that MK data can be pulled from the ECB Data Portal; also means any MK-vs-EU comparison requires an explicit definitional bridge between NBRSM and ECB concepts.

negative_findings.description: No public rating-agency report on MK banks was located. Searches for Fitch/Moody's/S&P coverage of Komercijalna banka and Stopanska banka returned only secondary press (a bne IntelliNews item on a sovereign downgrade to 'BB') and the banks' own investor presentations, not agency documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Rating-agency primary output on MK banks appears to be behind registration/subscription; only the sovereign rating narrative is publicly visible via press.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The rating-agency leg of this cell cannot be automated from open sources; it needs either free agency registration (Fitch and Moody's issue some press releases to registered users at no cost) or reliance on issuer IR decks and trade press as proxies.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before planned queries on BIS CPMI Red Book coverage of non-member jurisdictions, EBRD Transition Report / Banking Environment and Performance Survey for MK, SeeNews and Seebiz regional coverage, Mastercard/Visa/Worldpay Global Payments Report MK entries, and Macedonian-language queries for archived tariff books ('архивиран тарифник', 'стара верзија тарифник').
negative_findings.result_summary: Several planned aggregator/archive avenues in this cell were never searched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell is good but not exhaustive; a follow-up run with fresh search budget should complete these branches before the cell is treated as closed.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language search was performed (one substantive Cyrillic query on analytical banking/payments studies for the Western Balkans and MK), but no Macedonian-language commercial aggregator, archive service or local analyst house was found. All aggregator-layer sources in this cell are English-language and foreign; the only MK-language hits were primary institutional sources (NBRSM, Ministry of Finance/UFR, bank product pages, Sitel news).
negative_findings.result_summary: The aggregator/archive layer for MK payments appears to have no domestic MK-language equivalent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that for this cell the local-language route leads back to primary sources (other cells' territory), and that the archive layer must carry the MK-language burden — Wayback snapshots of MK-language NBRSM and bank pages, which is why the CDX approach ranks critical here.

negative_findings.description: Two aggregators refused automated access during this run: ceicdata.com returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch (though a plain curl to the same URL returned 200), and thebanks.eu returned HTTP 403 to curl with a browser user-agent. fred.stlouisfed.org returned no response (code 000) to curl from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot defences and environment-level connectivity, not dead links; all three should be treated as live-but-defended pending the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must assume browser-grade fetching (or licensed APIs) for the commercial aggregator layer, not naive HTTP clients.

negative_findings.description: No public source found that ties a specific large MK merchant or chain to a named acquirer with volumes or terminal counts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk and en for retail/fuel chain + acquirer announcements returned generic processor marketing (CaSys, Monri) and vendor case studies, but no merchant-level acquiring disclosure or POS-count statement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acquiring share by merchant must therefore be inferred indirectly (checkout redirect hostnames, bank instalment-partner rosters, terms PDFs), not read off any single published source.

negative_findings.description: No official ЈПДП (Public Enterprise for State Roads) toll-payment page was surfaced in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Toll evidence came from Makedonski Telekom's M-TAG page and MK media (Faktor, Sitel, Plusinfo, MMS); the road operator's own site did not appear in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The operator is the authoritative source for toll payment-mix and electronic-lane rollout; its absence leaves the toll segment media-dependent.

negative_findings.description: Session web-search budget was exhausted (200/200) before airlines, e-commerce marketplaces (pazar3, grouper), delivery platforms (Glovo/Wolt MK), A1 Macedonia payment pages, and Ramstore/Tinex/Vero corporate payment pages could be searched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Six mk/en query pairs were executed; the seventh was refused by the budget guard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Several named sub-segments of this coverage cell remain unsearched, so the candidate list under-represents marketplaces, delivery apps and airlines.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) searching was performed, although Albanian is widely used commercially in MK.
negative_findings.result_summary: Run scope specified languages mk,en only; Albanian merchant payment pages (e.g. mënyrat e pagesës) were therefore not covered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchants and municipalities in western MK publish payment information in Albanian; that layer of the acceptance landscape is unmapped.

negative_findings.description: Every attempted WebFetch against www.nbrm.mk (register pages, bylaw index) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, while the same pages are present in search-engine indexes.
negative_findings.result_summary: 3 of 3 nbrm.mk .nspx fetches returned 403; content confirmed to exist via search snippets. Treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source family in this cell (statutory registers) cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client; the pipeline needs a headless browser or UA/header-tuned fetcher, otherwise this cell silently produces zero data.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated North Macedonian interchange-fee regulation (an MK analogue of EU Regulation 2015/751 IFR) was located, and no Commission for Protection of Competition (Комисија за заштита на конкуренцијата) decision on card interchange surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in mk and en for интерчејнџ / заменски надоместок / interchange cap. Only found that the PSPS Law defines 'заменски надоместок' (interchange fee); no cap-setting instrument identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no interchange cap exists, MK card economics differ structurally from the EU and any assumption of an EU-style 0.2%/0.3% cap would be wrong. This must be resolved from the statutory text before any market conclusion is drawn.

negative_findings.description: No official NBRSM page or document specifically dedicated to a domestic instant-payments scheme rulebook or go-live date was located; evidence for instant payments is currently indirect (media relaying NBRSM/ECB statements about joining a TIPS-based regional platform, plus SEPA accession).
negative_findings.result_summary: mk and en searches returned the MIPS RTGS page, media coverage, and EPC/EC SEPA material, but no primary instant-payments scheme documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The go-live date and scheme rules are the key dated event for this cell; relying on media alone risks recording an announced date as an achieved one.

negative_findings.description: No machine-readable (API, CSV, open-data) endpoint was found for any NBRSM licence register; all evidence points to HTML pages and PDFs only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No data.gov.mk or NBRSM open-data endpoint surfaced for payment institution / EMI registers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be scrape-and-diff rather than API polling, raising fragility and the need for change detection on page structure.

negative_findings.description: The exact Official Gazette citation of the PSPS Law is reported inconsistently across secondary sources (No. 90/22 appears in the ENER-derived summary; the seed prompt context suggested 178/21; the NBRSM consolidated-text filename carries suffix 144-25 implying a later amendment).
negative_findings.result_summary: Three different issue numbers encountered; none confirmed by direct reading of the Gazette.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Gazette number and date are the anchor for every downstream regulatory event; the pipeline must resolve this from the consolidated PDF's own header rather than from search snippets.

negative_findings.description: Casys and KIBS (the domestic card processor and clearing house, likely 'оператори на платни системи' under the law) did not surface as licensed-operator entries in any accessible register listing during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted mk query naming Casys and KIBS returned only bank T&C PDFs and the NBRSM card-statistics page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payment system operator register is the pointer to domestic switch/clearing infrastructure; not confirming its contents leaves a hole in the actor map.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of the ЕСЈН public access page (https://www.e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/Home.aspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. The site is additionally an Angular single-page app addressed by hash routes, so even a successful plain fetch would return an empty shell. This is a hypothesis of bot defence, NOT evidence the portal is dead — third-party aggregators are actively indexing live dossier URLs from it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell cannot be collected with naive HTTP. Collection design must budget for a headless browser or for reverse-engineering the SPA's JSON XHR endpoints.

negative_findings.description: No specific, currently-live North Macedonian public tender for ATMs, POS terminals or card personalisation was surfaced by open web search in either mk or en.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned the portals and the legal framework but no individual banking-hardware notice. The only ATM/POS tender text retrieved was from an unrelated Ethiopian bank, and 'card personalisation' matched an unrelated company profile.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that item-level tender intelligence in this cell is not reachable through general search engines — it requires querying ЕСЈН directly by CPV code. Absence in search results is not absence of tenders.

negative_findings.description: No State Audit Office report specifically on cash operations of Пошта / the postal savings channel was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ДЗР report register was confirmed to exist and be public, but the specific audit was not found via search. The register is filterable and full-text searchable at source, which search engines do not index well.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Postal cash-handling audits would be a high-value read on non-bank cash volumes. This should be re-attempted by crawling the ДЗР register directly rather than by search engine.

negative_findings.description: The State Appeals Commission (ДКЖЈН) appears under at least three hosts: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk and dkzjn.sorsix.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documents were observed on both dkzjn.gov.mk and dkzjn.mk; dkzjn.sorsix.com appears to be a vendor-hosted (Sorsix) deployment. The canonical production host was not determined.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at a stale host will silently miss decisions. Canonical host must be resolved before scheduling collection.

negative_findings.description: The Center for Civil Communications (ЦГК) was confirmed as an active procurement-monitoring organisation but its current website domain was not observed in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Evidence of its work came via Facebook, OGP documents and secondary citations. ccc.org.mk is an inference and must be verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Its quarterly monitoring reports and municipal procurement database are the best analytical layer over raw ЕСЈН data; a wrong domain loses that.

negative_findings.description: Whether data.gov.mk actually hosts structured public-procurement datasets could not be confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: The OGP action plan contains an explicit commitment titled 'Јавните набавки како отворени податоци', and the open-data portal exists, but no procurement dataset was directly observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If such a dataset exists it would be the cheapest, most legally clean bulk route into ЕСЈН data and would remove the 403/SPA problem entirely. Worth a direct catalogue query.

negative_findings.description: No confirmed POS-terminal series for North Macedonia was located inside the IMF FAS results surfaced by search; only ATM-per-100,000-adults values for MK were visible. FAS documentation states POS terminals were added as a newer access-point indicator, but MK reporting of it is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM density for MK found via FAS/World Bank/FRED; MK POS density not confirmed at the supranational layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POS terminal density is a core A4 metric; if FAS does not carry MK POS data, the national central bank payment statistics become the only source and the international benchmark cannot be built.

negative_findings.description: Supranational and donor bodies in this cell (IMF, World Bank, EBRD, CEB, TED, OECD-style benchmarks) publish essentially only in English for North Macedonia; Macedonian-language material found was national-government mirroring of EU documents (MEP, Ministry of Finance, MDT portal) rather than donor-original publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language queries returned government mirrors and media coverage, not donor primary sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Macedonian-language monitoring of this cell should target government EU-integration portals rather than the donors themselves; searching donor sites in mk will keep returning nothing.

negative_findings.description: The CEB country page URL for North Macedonia and the current EBRD PSD search URL were inferred from site navigation patterns rather than observed directly; EBRD restructured its website and legacy PSD/SolrSearch URLs appear to redirect.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both entries recorded with reduced confidence; treat as hypotheses for the liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector hard-coding these paths may 404; the discovery pass should resolve them from the site root instead.

negative_findings.description: No donor-funded project dedicated specifically to card/ATM/POS acceptance infrastructure in North Macedonia was identified. Donor digitalisation money found is directed at SME digital technology on-lending (EBRD Go Digital), public administration and PFM IT (IPA), and the digital economy broadly (World Bank NODE).
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-acceptance infrastructure is not an explicit donor line item in the material found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a donor project register to describe the acceptance market directly; the donor layer is mainly useful for benchmarks, conditionality (SEPA) and adjacent IT tenders.

negative_findings.finding_type: actor does not exist as named
negative_findings.description: The coverage cell names 'Postenska/Пошта' as a commercial bank. No licensed 'Поштенска банка' was found in the current MK bank universe. What exists instead is Пошта на Северна Македонија (Post of North Macedonia) acting as a distribution channel — Halkbank services are reported as available through 327 active post-office units.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched mk and en for Поштенска банка / Post bank North Macedonia; only the postal operator and the Halkbank-post distribution arrangement surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a phantom actor from being carried into the source register, and reframes the postal network correctly as an agent/access-point channel (relevant to cash-usage and payment-access-point analysis) rather than a bank issuing cards.

negative_findings.finding_type: metric not disclosed in accessible form
negative_findings.description: No MK bank was found publishing an absolute, machine-readable count of cards issued, ATMs owned or POS terminals deployed on an indexable web page. Where the metric exists it is prose inside an annual-report PDF, and often only as a YoY percentage (Стопанска банка reports '+12% card transactions', '+20% POS/e-commerce', '+9% merchant points' with no base numbers).
negative_findings.result_summary: Six bank-specific searches in mk plus targeted en searches returned narrative/percentage disclosure only; no per-bank fleet-count table found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS series cannot be built bottom-up from bank disclosures alone at absolute-value precision; bank sources give growth rates and qualitative direction, and must be anchored to a regulator/scheme aggregate for levels.

negative_findings.description: No MK bank was observed publishing a document explicitly branded 'Pillar 3' in the EU sense. The local equivalent appears to be the NBRM-mandated 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' public disclosure (confirmed for ТТК Банка as at 31.12.2024). Genuine Pillar-3 documents exist only at parent-group level (ProCredit Holding under CRR 575/2013).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'pillar 3' + MK bank names returned only group-level holding documents; the local template was found under its Macedonian title instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Anyone searching for 'Pillar 3 MK bank' will get near-zero recall; the correct local search key is 'Извештај и податоци за Банката', which should be used as the cross-bank retrieval string.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were obtained from search-engine result listings. No page was independently fetched and confirmed reachable during this run, and no liveness or HTTP-status claim is made for any of them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery-only pass; deterministic verification deferred to the downstream pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confidence scores here reflect that the URL was returned by search for the stated entity, not that it resolves today; some deep PDF paths (Cyrillic-encoded, CMS-generated) are the most likely to have moved.

negative_findings.description: Several search keys are noisy: 'Halkbank' collides with Halkbank Turkey, Halkbank a.d. Serbia and Halkbank Turkmenistan; 'Sparkasse' collides with the entire Austrian/German Sparkassen sector; 'Komercijalna banka' collides with NLB Komercijalna banka Beograd; 'НЛБ' returns Slovenian group material. 'Развојна банка' can also refer to development banks generally.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed directly in results — e.g. Halkbank queries returned Turkmenistan and Serbian entities; NLB queries returned Serbian Komercijalna banka pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection must pin queries with 'АД Скопје' / 'AD Skopje' / site: filters, otherwise the corpus silently fills with cross-border homonyms and the MK figures get contaminated.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated investor-relations page with quarterly presentations was found for any MK bank other than Комерцијална банка (which publishes dated KB-PREZENTACIJA PDFs). Other banks appear to disclose only annually, via AGM packs or exchange filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Per-bank searches for 'инвеститори' / 'investor presentation' returned nothing comparable outside kb.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Intra-year monitoring of the MK bank sector will be driven almost entirely by Комерцијална банка's presentations plus NLB Group's quarterly reports; everyone else is an annual-cadence source.

negative_findings.description: No MK bank was found publishing an explicit merchant acquiring price list (MSC/merchant discount rate per card scheme, POS terminal rental, e-commerce gateway fee) as a public, dated document. Public corporate tariffs cover accounts, transfers and business cards; acquiring pricing appears to be contract-negotiated.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk and en queries on 'провизија за трговец', 'прифаќање картички', 'POS терминал изнајмување', 'merchant acquiring price list' returned only general terms of business (STB) and third-party explainers, no numeric merchant pricing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acquiring economics — the core of cash-vs-card merchant incentives — cannot be read directly from tariffs; it must be inferred from general terms, interchange regulation, media and merchant-side sources.

negative_findings.description: No published interchange-fee cap schedule or interchange-level disclosure specific to North Macedonia was located; the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems defines 'заменски надоместок' but no public per-scheme rate table was found in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk query on интерчејнџ/меѓубанкарски надоместок returned law texts, a parliamentary amendment proposal (levica.mk) and media commentary on bank fee income, but no rate schedule.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without interchange rates, pass-through analysis from issuer tariffs to merchant costs stays qualitative.

negative_findings.description: Tariff documents for Силк Роуд Банка, Развојна банка на Северна Македонија, and Зират банка (Ziraat) were not surfaced by the queries run in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Combined mk query naming these institutions returned results only for CCB, Sparkasse, ProCredit, NLB and Capital.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of the smaller-bank tier is incomplete; Development Bank is not a retail issuer but Silk Road and Ziraat are.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language public price lists were found for licensed non-bank payment institutions or e-money institutions; the local term set ('ценовник', 'тарифа на платежна институција') produced only the regulator's registers, not institution-level pricing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register pages found; individual institution tariffs not located because the entity list itself was not retrievable in this pass (nbrm.mk 403 on automated fetch).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Non-bank PSPs are the fastest-moving segment for cash-out/cash-in pricing and are missing from the tariff corpus.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetches of nbrm.mk and provizii.mk returned HTTP 403. Treated as bot defence, not as dead links.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of three planned WebFetch calls on these hosts returned 403 Forbidden with no body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The two most valuable index/pointer sources for this cell need a browser-grade collector rather than a plain HTTP fetcher.

negative_findings.description: The coverage cell names 'Мкх/national card scheme'. Searching in Macedonian for a domestic card scheme ('национална картичка шема', 'домашна платежна картичка', 'домашен картичен систем') returned no evidence of a four-party national card scheme in North Macedonia. The phrase 'домашна платежна картичка' refers to the 2020 government stimulus card ('Купувам домашно', ~324,479 recipients, ~EUR 28m), a prepaid social-support instrument issued via commercial banks — not a scheme.
negative_findings.result_summary: No national card scheme found; CaSys (Интернационален картичен систем АД Скопје) is a processor/switch, not a scheme. The 'Мкх' token in the cell brief could not be resolved to any real Macedonian entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream analyst from hunting a non-existent scheme operator and from mistaking the 2020 stimulus card for domestic scheme infrastructure. Domestic card rails in MK run on CaSys processing over Visa/Mastercard scheme rails.

negative_findings.description: Neither KIBS nor CaSys appears to publish transaction or terminal statistics on its own website. The KIBS site surfaces mission/vision, news, OneID, instant-payment and eIDAS/trust-service material but no statistics section; the CaSys 'About us' page discloses no volumes, client-bank list, or customer counts.
negative_findings.result_summary: The two actors with transaction- and terminal-level truth publish essentially no numbers voluntarily.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Volume intelligence for this cell must be sourced indirectly — NBRM aggregate statistics, Central Registry financials, MSE issuer disclosures, and executive interviews — rather than from the operators. Collection design should assume this permanently.

negative_findings.description: www.nbrm.mk .nspx pages returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetcher, and kibs.com.mk failed TLS hostname validation (certificate covers kibs.mk / *.kibs.mk).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are hypotheses of bot defence / host-alias misconfiguration, not evidence of dead sources — kibs.mk fetched successfully, and nbrm.mk /content/ PDFs appear in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive verification pass will wrongly mark the single most important statistics domain in this cell as dead. The collector needs a headless-browser or header-spoofing path for nbrm.mk and should canonicalise KIBS to kibs.mk.

negative_findings.description: Searches of Visa and Mastercard newsrooms and investor material found no North Macedonia country-level card, contactless or acceptance statistics. Mastercard's MK-specific output is the 2021 National Digital Identity Service launch with the government and NLB Banka; Visa material is CEE/global (Tap to Phone, contactless adoption) with no MK breakout.
negative_findings.result_summary: Global schemes are a partnership/product-signal source for MK, not a statistics source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: scheme-published MK numbers should not be planned into the data model; NBRM remains the only quantitative anchor.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language term or local presence was found for American Express in the MK market. Searching 'American Express картичка Северна Македонија лиценца' surfaced only Diners Club material and generic acceptance lists; no local Amex licensee or issuing bank was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Amex appears to have no identifiable local licensee entity in MK; acceptance seems to run through acquirers rather than a domestic licence holder.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes 'Diners/Amex local licensees' plural. Only Diners Club Macedonia is confirmed as a local licensee; the Amex half of that assumption is unsupported and should be flagged before any analyst builds on it.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific SWIFT source was located. Searches surfaced SEPA accession material but nothing on SWIFT country membership, MK BIC directories, or SWIFT traffic data for North Macedonia; local-language terms for SWIFT are simply the English acronym ('СВИФТ'/'SWIFT'), which is too noisy to isolate.
negative_findings.result_summary: SWIFT-side MK data not found in this pass; SWIFT's own RMB/traffic trackers do not appear to break out MK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-border messaging volumes for MK will likely have to be inferred from NBRM balance-of-payments and MIPS EUR-leg data rather than from SWIFT.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/registar-na-institucii-za-elektronski-pari.nspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The page is indexed by search engines and other nbrm.mk pages are widely referenced, so this is almost certainly bot protection rather than a dead page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not read the authoritative EMI register contents; the licensed-entity list had to be reconstructed indirectly from press reports (Paysera Македонија, Iute Pay).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The register is the single authoritative roster for this cell; without it the actor map is press-derived and may be incomplete or stale.

negative_findings.description: No separate, publicly visible NBRSM register page for payment institutions (as distinct from e-money institutions) or for payment-system operators was surfaced by either mk or en searches, although the licensing decision on registers implies all three exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the EMI register URL was recovered; the PI and operator register URLs remain unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment institutions (not EMIs) are likely the larger population — remittance and acquiring-adjacent actors — so the actor map has a structural hole.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated MK register or supervised list of crypto-asset service providers / crypto exchanges was found; local reporting describes crypto exchanges as operating legally but without a licensing regime.
negative_findings.result_summary: Crypto-adjacent payment apps in MK cannot currently be enumerated from any official register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The crypto-adjacent portion of this cell must be tracked through company sites and press only, with low completeness confidence.

negative_findings.description: Searches did not surface a Ria Money Transfer MK country/agent page or an official Pošta na Severna Makedonija remittance-payout page, even though Ria is named among the channels operating in MK.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ria's and the postal network's MK distribution footprint is undocumented in what I found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Postal and Ria networks are typically material rural cash-out channels; missing them understates the non-bank payout footprint.

negative_findings.description: The Paysera Македонија corporate URL (paysera.mk) is my inference from the entity name, not a URL I observed in results; only the IT.mk article about its e-money approval was actually surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Candidate recorded with low confidence and an explicit verification instruction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recording an inferred URL as if observed would violate the no-fabrication rule; the downstream verification pass must resolve it.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf press release, case study or contract announcement surfaced in this pass, in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed English query returned only global/US ATM-industry coverage; no Macedonia item.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The two dominant ATM OEMs appear to reach MK banks only through regional channel partners (Printec, Payten/Asseco), so OEM newsrooms are low-yield and the channel layer must carry the intelligence load.

negative_findings.description: No named authorised Ingenico, Verifone or PAX distributor for North Macedonia was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both the English OEM-partner query and the Macedonian distributor query returned only foreign resellers (RU/UA/BY/US) and generic Wikipedia pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Terminal supply attribution for the MK POS estate is currently unresolved; the estate is probably supplied through the acquirers/processors (CaSys, Payten) rather than a visible retail distributor.

negative_findings.description: UJP does not appear to publish an accessible list of approved fiscal-device manufacturers, importers and authorised servicers at a stable URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian query returned the law text and UJP notices about servicing obligations, but no downloadable approved-device or approved-servicer register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: That register would be the single best enumeration of merchant-side hardware suppliers and their market shares; without it the merchant-terminal supplier map has to be assembled firm by firm.

negative_findings.description: MoneyGet (Asseco independent ATM network) has confirmed country sites for RS, HR, ME and an EU hub, but no North Macedonia instance was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language query returned only neighbouring-country MoneyGet sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no IAD layer exists in MK, published ATM counts can be read as bank-owned estate; that assumption should be verified before modelling.

negative_findings.description: No procurement-portal route to MK bank ATM/POS tenders was found; MK commercial banks are private and do not tender through e-nabavki.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian tender query returned only bank ATM-locator pages and investor presentations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: the supplier side (vendor references, trade press, cash-firm profiles) is the only practical route to procurement-level intelligence in MK.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell rationale flags that MK and EN NBRSM pages can carry different granularity, but with both pages returning 403 the MK-vs-EN table inventory could not be compared.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-grade fetch of platiezhna_statistika.nspx and platiezhna_statistika-en.nspx and diff the attached file lists to determine which language version is authoritative per dataset.

coverage_gaps.description: The actual XLSX/PDF payment-statistics table URLs (per-terminal-type transactions, POS card value, cards issued) were never enumerated because the parent pages are bot-blocked; only a naming pattern (/WBStorage/Files/Platni sistemi_*) and one historical example were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the /WBStorage/Files/ and /content/statistika/ file trees via a rendered crawl of the statistics and payment-systems pages; build a stable file inventory with checksums for change detection.

coverage_gaps.description: KIBS AD Skopje (the clearing house operating the retail net-settlement system) was reached only through the central bank's description page; its own corporate site and volume statistics were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a follow-up cell to KIBS AD Skopje's own domain and to CaSys/card-processing operators for operator-published transaction and terminal statistics.

coverage_gaps.description: No advance release calendar for the payment statistics was captured, only the general rule (quarterly within 90 days of quarter end, annual within 90 days of year end) reported for the payment statistics page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and archive the NBRSM statistical release calendar from the statistics hub so collection can be scheduled to publication dates rather than polled blindly.

coverage_gaps.description: Depth of the back-series for card/ATM/POS statistics (earliest available year, methodological breaks) is unknown; a 2019 monetary-statistics change note was seen, implying breaks exist elsewhere too.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect NBRSM methodology/change notes under /content/statistika/informacii/ alongside the data so time series can be break-adjusted.

coverage_gaps.description: No register specifically enumerating licensed payment institutions and e-money issuers was located within this cell; the Central Registry lists legal entities generically and the licensing register is held by the central bank.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference the NBRSM licence register (other cell) against CRM entity profiles by EMBS to build a joined actor table.

coverage_gaps.description: Most UJP and Central Registry material is Macedonian-only; English mirrors exist for SSO but were not systematically compared for content parity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each source, record whether an /en path exists and whether it lags the Macedonian version; default collection to Macedonian.

coverage_gaps.description: SSO household budget survey (Анкета за потрошувачка на домаќинствата) and its treatment of cash vs non-cash expenditure was not examined in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on 'Анкета за потрошувачка на домаќинствата' and SSO micro-data access rules for cash-usage evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: The Bureau for Public Procurement e-procurement system (e-nabavki), which would reveal bank/POS/ATM vendor contracts, falls outside this cell's four institutions but is adjacent to the Open Finance portal captured here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign e-nabavki.gov.mk to a procurement-focused cell or add it in a follow-up slice.

coverage_gaps.description: Merchant-side sector bodies beyond the generic Trade Association are unmapped: no located association for supermarkets/FMCG retail chains, petrol retail, or hospitality with its own publication stream.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full mchamber.mk associations and групации indices (/mk/home/zdruzenijainfo/{1..N}, /mk/home/grupacii/{1..N}) by ID sweep and classify each by relevance to card acceptance and cash handling.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language association and chamber content was not searched at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq query set (shoqata e tregtarëve, oda ekonomike, pagesa me kartelë, komision, para në dorë/kesh) and crawl oemvp.org/sq plus Albanian-language business media.

coverage_gaps.description: Member lists were located as URLs (MBA /clenovi/, MASIT /members-of-masit/) but not extracted into an actor registry, and several bodies (chamber associations, BCM, chamber.mk) may not publish machine-readable member lists at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a member-list extraction job across mba.mk, masit.org.mk and amcham.mk first (these clearly publish), then assess whether the chamber associations expose rosters or only leadership; where absent, reconstruct membership from event participant lists and news mentions.

coverage_gaps.description: Association-produced surveys with numbers are thin — only the e-commerce association clearly publishes payment-preference survey content. No association-run merchant or consumer survey on cash vs card was otherwise found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deep-crawl ecommerce.mk's full article archive for survey series and methodology, and check the regional ecommerce4all.eu e-payment module; separately check MBA /za-nas/izveshtai/ for statistical annexes.

coverage_gaps.description: Only a 2018 edition of the Foreign Investors Council White Book was observed, and chamber annual reports were seen for scattered years (2010, 2020, 2022).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically enumerate yearly editions of both document series and mirror them, so cross-year changes in stated payment/banking friction can be diffed.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer grievance signal is richest where it is least collectible — ОПМ's complaint intake is a submission form (must not be interacted with) and its most active channel is Facebook, which is login-walled and ToS-restricted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on ОПМ's published articles, handbooks and annual reports; consider a direct information request to ОПМ for aggregate complaint counts by sector rather than any automated social collection.

coverage_gaps.description: All identified outlets are Skopje-centric national media. No regional MK outlets (Bitola, Kumanovo, Tetovo, Ohrid, Štip) were identified, yet branch/ATM withdrawal is a rural and secondary-city phenomenon first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run city-scoped MK queries (банкомат Битола / експозитура Куманово) and mine TIME.mk / GRID.mk publisher lists for regional domains.

coverage_gaps.description: No merchant-side or consumer-association voice was located — no retail association, chamber of commerce media channel, or consumer-protection organisation covering card acceptance costs and interchange complaints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search for Стопанска комора / Организација на потрошувачите / здружение на трговци statements on интерчејџ / провизија; likely a separate cell but currently unclaimed here.

coverage_gaps.description: No paywalled/print archive access was established for the business weeklies (Kapital print edition, Fokus), so pre-web and subscriber-only reporting is out of reach.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess subscription cost for Kapital; check national/university library digital archives for MK press backfiles.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched; all were obtained from search-result metadata. Liveness, paywall state, robots.txt and feed availability are unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/robots pass over every URL here before scheduling any crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: Broadcast and social-first channels are underrepresented: only Telma and Alsat were captured, and no YouTube/Facebook broadcast archives were assessed, though MK banking executives frequently make first statements in TV interviews.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the business programmes of Telma, Alsat, Sitel, Kanal 5 and TV21 and their YouTube archives; assess transcript feasibility.

coverage_gaps.description: Primary career pages of the ~13 MK banks, plus CaSys, KIBS, Diners Club MK, Paysera MK and the payment institutions/e-money institutions registered with NBRSM, are not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBRSM registers of banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators, then resolve each entity to its careers URL and LinkedIn page to form a fixed watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: The MK functional vocabulary for payments roles is only partially assembled (картично работење, платен промет, банкомати, самоуслужни производи, платежни решенија, засилена автентикација).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a full mk keyword set including еквајринг, издавање картички, процесирање, ПОС мрежа, тргoвци, инстант плаќања, СЕПА, отворено банкарство, and their English-in-Macedonian variants, and validate each against real ad text before locking filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language sources not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq query set (shpallje pune bankë Shkup kartela pagesa; konferencë fintech Shkup) and check South East European University and Mother Teresa University output.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy identified for vacancy text, which is deleted once a post expires — the signal is perishable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Capture ad full text at discovery time and store it, and check Wayback coverage of bankarstvo.mk and the main job boards to backfill a historical hiring series.

coverage_gaps.description: Event agendas and speaker lists were identified at organiser level but no past-edition agenda was actually retrieved, so the speaker-to-institution map is unbuilt.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the last three editions of the Regional E-commerce Conference and MASIT specialised events; extract speaker names, titles and employers into an actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side signals for the ATM/POS supply chain (Payten, Printec, Diebold/NCR partners, ASSECO SEE in MK) were not located — the vendor query returned only Nextsense.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted mk+en queries per vendor name plus 'Скопје'/'Македонија', and check the Central Register and public-procurement portal for their MK legal entities and bank contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — the richest layer — is not lawfully pipelineable, and e-Rabota is an ASP.NET postback form that resists simple crawling.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design a hybrid: automated collection on open aggregators (bankarstvo.mk, vrabotuvanje, apliciraj), scheduled manual review for LinkedIn, and a session-aware fetcher for e-Rabota.

coverage_gaps.description: No card-processing or ATM-operating infrastructure actor was captured (e.g. the national card processor, the interbank clearing operator, independent ATM deployers, or the banking association), all of which hold ATM/POS estate data not visible in central-bank aggregates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted MK searches for КИБС, КаСис, Македонска банкарска асоцијација and 'независни оператори на банкомати', plus the NBRM register of payment institutions and payment-system operators at https://www.nbrm.mk/platezni-institucii-institucii-za-elektronski-pari-i-operatori-na-platni-sistemi.nspx

coverage_gaps.description: Primary Official Gazette texts for the AML cash ceiling and for the Law on Registration of Cash Payments were not obtained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and register the Службен весник portal and any consolidated-law service, then pin the article-level citations for each cash threshold and each fiscalisation duty.

coverage_gaps.description: No source was found that directly reports the cash share of retail transactions (as opposed to cash withdrawals or currency in circulation). Media report qualitatively that cash is still preferred, and NBRM data support an ATM-withdrawal-to-POS-purchase ratio, but no survey-based cash-share series surfaced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether NBRM or a donor programme (EBRD, World Bank, EU) has run a payment-diary or consumer-payment-attitudes survey for MK; also test Global Findex MK microdata for cash-use questions.

coverage_gaps.description: ATM network density is available only at national level (per 100k adults). No municipality- or region-level ATM/POS distribution source was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check NBRM payment statistics tables for regional breakdowns and the SSO regional statistics; failing that, treat bank branch/ATM locator pages as a scrape-derived indirect source.

coverage_gaps.description: The Finance Think homepage URL was inferred from the institute's name rather than observed in a search result, unlike every other candidate URL in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the correct Finance Think domain before adding it to any collection schedule; treat the current URL as a hypothesis.

coverage_gaps.description: Card-scheme and payments-industry research (Visa, Mastercard, Worldpay/FIS Global Payments Report, Nilson Report, Euromonitor Consumer Finance) was not searched; these vendors publish MK or Southeast-Europe card-volume and payment-mix estimates that are the closest commercial analogue to official card statistics.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: In a follow-up run, query for 'Worldpay Global Payments Report North Macedonia', 'Mastercard Western Balkans cashless', 'Euromonitor consumer payments North Macedonia', and check whether any free country annex exists.

coverage_gaps.description: BIS CPMI Red Book / CPMI statistics and EBRD outputs (Transition Report, Banking Environment and Performance Survey) were not reached before the search budget ran out.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search BIS CPMI statistics for any Western Balkans coverage and EBRD publications for MK financial-sector chapters; both are free and highly citable comparator sources.

coverage_gaps.description: The Wayback CDX enumeration was run only for nbrm.mk with a 'platni' filter and a 25-row limit. The same technique has not been applied to nbstat.nbrm.mk, stat.gov.mk, the nine MK commercial bank domains, KIBS (the domestic clearing house), or the MK card-scheme/processor sites, and no 'karti'/'tarif'/'statistik' filters were run against nbrm.mk itself.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a systematic CDX sweep over a defined MK domain list with filters on karti|tarif|statistik|platni|izvestaj|godisen, no row limit, collapse by digest, and store the full snapshot inventory as the archive backbone for the whole run.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the Internet Archive was used. Other preservation routes — archive.today/archive.ph, Common Crawl, Bing/Google cache, national or library web archives, and the EU/Europeana web-archiving initiatives — were not tested for MK banking pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test archive.today and Common Crawl index lookups for nbrm.mk and MK bank domains; note that archive.today is aggressively bot-defended and may need manual access.

coverage_gaps.description: For every paid aggregator in this cell (CEIC, Trading Economics, Statista, Mordor/ResearchAndMarkets, bne IntelliNews, TheBanks.eu) it is unknown whether the organisation already holds a subscription, which determines whether these become collectable sources or stay reference-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish the existing subscription inventory before the collection routine is built, and mark collection_allowed accordingly; where no subscription exists, prefer the free substitutes identified here (DBnomics, World Bank API, IMF FAS, ECB Data Portal).

coverage_gaps.description: No comparator peer group has been fixed for MK. ECB PAY, World Bank and IMF FAS all allow arbitrary country selections, but without an agreed peer set (WB6 neighbours vs recent EU entrants vs euro-area small states) benchmark outputs will not be reproducible across runs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fix a standing comparator list (suggest: AL, RS, BA, ME, XK for regional; BG, RO, HR, GR, SI for EU/euro-adjacent) and hard-code it into every aggregator pull.

coverage_gaps.description: Airlines and travel merchants operating in MK (carriers selling MKD-denominated tickets, Skopje/Ohrid airport operator TAV) were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search mk+en for airport and airline MK payment/checkout pages and for airport concession POS suppliers; add TAV Macedonia to the actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: Marketplaces and delivery/on-demand platforms (pazar3.mk, grouper.mk, Glovo/Wolt MK) are absent — these are the highest-frequency card-not-present merchants in the country.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated query round: 'плаќање со картичка апликација достава Македонија', 'pazar3 плаќање', 'Glovo Македонија картичка'; capture their checkout gateway hostnames.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic mechanism yet defined for detecting acquirer/gateway from checkout redirects across the MK webshop population.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a crawler that resolves the 3DS/redirect host (e.g. cpay.com.mk, monri hosts, bank hosts) for a ranked list of MK merchant domains; this yields a quantitative gateway-share estimate no regulator publishes.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal utilities outside Skopje and Prilep (топлификација, комунални претпријатија in Bitola, Tetovo, Kumanovo, Ohrid) and their card-payment portals are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate MK municipalities and crawl their public-enterprise sites for 'плати сметка' / 'електронско плаќање' pages, in mk and sq.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language acceptance sources not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq terms ('mënyrat e pagesës', 'pagesa me kartelë', 'faturat online') to the next run for merchants, municipalities and transit in western MK.

coverage_gaps.description: nbrm.mk is bot-defended (403 to plain fetchers), and it hosts the majority of the primary sources in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a headless-browser / realistic-header fetch path for nbrm.mk to the collector, with polite rate limiting; validate against the .nspx register pages before declaring any of them unreachable.

coverage_gaps.description: The payment institution register and payment system operator register pages were identified only via the hub page; their direct URLs were not confirmed (only the e-money register URL was).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl https://www.nbrm.mk/platezni-institucii-institucii-za-elektronski-pari-i-operatori-na-platni-sistemi.nspx with a browser and enumerate the child register URLs, then register each as its own source.

coverage_gaps.description: Interchange / merchant service charge regulation in MK is unresolved: term exists in law ('заменски надоместок') but no cap instrument or competition-authority decision found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the consolidated PSPS Law PDF directly for the interchange chapter, and separately search the Commission for Protection of Competition (kzk.gov.mk) decision database in Macedonian for card-scheme and bank cases.

coverage_gaps.description: Instant payments coverage rests on media and EU/EPC sources; no primary domestic scheme documentation captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Monitor NBRSM press releases and the payments conference materials, plus ECB/TIPS and Banka Slovenije-hosted regional-platform announcements, for the MK go-live notice and rulebook.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language sources were not searched, although Albanian is an official language in North Macedonia and some regulatory content is published in it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian (sq) query pass for 'shërbimet e pagesave', 'institucion pagese', 'Banka Popullore e Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut' if the run scope is widened beyond mk/en.

coverage_gaps.description: No court/administrative-enforcement source (sanctions, licence withdrawals, misdemeanour proceedings under the PSPS or AML law) was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the NBRSM sanctions/measures publications and sud.mk / Државен завод за ревизија for enforcement actions against payment service providers, which are the strongest evidence of real supervisory activity.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV codes for ATMs/banking machinery, payment terminals, card personalisation, cash-in-transit and core banking software were not established in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the CPV nomenclature from the БЈН manuals and map the relevant divisions (e.g. banking machinery under office/computing machinery, security and cash-transport services, banking and financial services, software packages). CPV filtering, not keyword search, is the reliable way to enumerate this cell in ЕСЈН.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned and state-influenced financial institutions beyond Пошта were not individually enumerated — notably Развојна банка на Северна Македонија (MBDP/development bank), the Treasury (Трезор) within the Ministry of Finance, Фонд за здравствено осигурување (ФЗОМ) and Фонд за ПИОМ, all of which run mass disbursement/collection and card-related procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate these as contracting authorities in ЕСЈН and add each to the watchlist; check whether each also mirrors notices on its own site.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal-level contracting authorities (80+ општини, plus the City of Skopje) were treated collectively rather than individually. Municipal cash desks, parking payment machines and local utility collection are a meaningful slice of cash/card acceptance procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the ЦГК municipal procurement database (2015 onwards) plus the ЕСЈН authority list at https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/institutionGridData.aspx to build a complete municipal authority roster.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although Albanian is an official language and audit/procurement bodies publish bilingually (the State Audit Office brands itself Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian search terms — prokurimi publik, banka, bankomat, terminale POS, para në dorë, auditim — for municipalities in the west of the country and for bilingual national publications.

coverage_gaps.description: No machine-readable API into ЕСЈН was identified; the collection plan currently depends on browser automation or on third-party normalisation (Opentender/TED), each with coverage or licence limits.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect the ЕСЈН SPA's network traffic to document its JSON endpoints and pagination, and in parallel test data.gov.mk and a direct FOI/technical enquiry to БЈН about bulk or API access. Record whichever route is stable as the primary collection path.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of ЕСЈН public access (how far back notices and awards remain retrievable) is unknown, as is whether pre-2019-law records are comparable after the 2019 Law on Public Procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the earliest retrievable notice date in ЕСЈН and in Opentender's MK extract; document the 2019 law break in any time series.

coverage_gaps.description: Licence and terms-of-service position not resolved for two collection routes: Opentender's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 non-commercial licence, and the commercial aggregators' scraping terms.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before any commercial deliverable reuses those figures, confirm licensing; prefer deriving numbers from the primary ЕСЈН/TED records, which carry no such restriction.

coverage_gaps.description: Several plausible supranational actors in this cell were not searched in this pass: EIB / EIB Global, BIS (CPMI Red Book and statistics, likely non-member so probably absent), UNCDF, USAID/SIDA/SECO bilateral donors, the Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) project pipeline, and the Vienna Initiative / EFSE and Green for Growth funds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass over WBIF (wbif.eu) project pipeline, EIB project register, EFSE and the Vienna Initiative reports filtered on North Macedonia.

coverage_gaps.description: It was not established whether Findex 2025 country-level microdata for MK is openly downloadable or requires a licensed-access request, nor whether the MK sample supports card/POS-level breakdowns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open the MK microdata catalogue entry and read the access policy and questionnaire before planning collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage (a significant official language in MK) was entirely outside the run's declared language set and was not attempted for donor/EU material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If the run scope ever widens, add sq-language queries against EU delegation and government EU-integration portals.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete machine-access paths for IMF FAS (post-migration data.imf.org SDMX endpoints) and for the TED search API were not tested, only inferred.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prototype one SDMX call for MKD FAS indicators and one TED API query with a MK country filter to confirm parameters before building collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Капитал банка АД Скопје was named in a search but no reports page or filing repository was confirmed for it in this run; likewise no source was established for any remaining small/savings institutions ('штедилници') outside the main bank list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full licensed-institution list from the NBRM bank directory index and run one targeted mk-language 'финансиски извештаи' search per institution not yet covered here.

coverage_gaps.description: Absolute card/ATM/POS fleet counts per bank remain unsourced; bank disclosures give growth percentages and narrative only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with the regulator/scheme cell (NBRM payment-system statistics, KIBS/CaSys processing data) for levels, and use bank reports for attribution, mix and direction. Additionally scrape bank ATM locator endpoints as an independent fleet census.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language versions of MK bank annual reports were confirmed only for Sparkasse (historic), ProCredit and NLB Group. For Комерцијална, Стопанска, УНИ, ТТК, ЦКБ and Халк the operative documents are Macedonian Cyrillic PDFs, some of which appear to be scans.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for Cyrillic OCR plus a mk→en glossary in the extraction pipeline; do not assume an English mirror exists.

coverage_gaps.description: SEI-Net and SRIS both serve documents from opaque ID-keyed endpoints (FileServer.aspx?file=<id>, Document_SR<id>-<year>-<seq>.pdf); no listing API or per-issuer index URL was established, so systematic harvesting is not yet specified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a hands-on session against seinet.com.mk and sris.sec.gov.mk with a headless browser to capture the issuer-search request/response shape, then build an issuer-scoped crawler rather than guessing IDs.

coverage_gaps.description: Only recent report years (roughly 2019-2025) were sighted on live bank pages; older annual reports (e.g. Комерцијална 2016, Sparkasse 2013) surfaced only incidentally, suggesting banks prune their reports pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the historical back-series from the MSE/SEI-Net/SRIS repositories and web-archive snapshots rather than from bank websites, and mirror everything on first collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group disclosure was established for NLB Group and ProCredit Holding only. Halkbank Turkey (parent of Халкбанк АД Скопје), Steiermärkische Bank und Sparkassen AG (parent of Шпаркасе), OTP/NBG lineage for Стопанска банка and the Bulgarian CCB parent of ЦКБ were not searched at group level.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one dedicated parent-group search per foreign owner, targeting subsidiary/segment tables and country-by-country reporting, since parent reports are often more standardised than the MK filings.

coverage_gaps.description: Tariff sources located for roughly 10 of the ~13 MK banks; Silk Road Bank, Ziraat Bank and Development Bank of NM remain uncovered, and savings houses (штедилници) were not scouted at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-institution mk query pattern '<bank name> тарифа надоместоци pdf' against the NBRM list of licensed banks and savings houses to close the roster.
